title: rewards.redemption.confirmed v1
description: Emitted when a reward redemption request is confirmed and points are deducted. Source: alebrije-mod-rewards-go (Go). Delivery address is never included raw. STATUS 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards): NOT IMPLEMENTED. grep of the whole alebrije monorepo found zero producers of event_type rewards.redemption.confirmed; the real publisher (internal/service/events_publisher.go) confirms redemptions via rewards.redeemed instead (see rewards.redeemed.v1.json), with no separate fulfillment_ref / delivery_address_hash concept. Moved out of event-schemas/ into planned/ so the Go/Python/Elixir validators (which only scan the top-level schemas dir) stop registering a schema with no producer. Kept (not deleted) in case a future fulfillment-tracking flow is built on this contract; do not restore to the top-level dir until a real producer exists.

reward_id.description: UUID of the reward catalog entry redeemed.

fulfillment_ref.description: External fulfillment tracking reference (courier, gift code, etc.).

delivery_address_hash.description: SHA-256 of delivery address for dedup — never raw address (PII).
